tables.description: A rumor or quest hook overheard at the tavern

result.text: The old well has begun to whisper names at night.
A merchant caravan vanished on the high road, leaving only its horses.
Blue lights have been seen over the ruined tower.
The chapel bell rings at midnight, though no one is inside.
A map was found showing a door that isn't there yet.
The herbalist's entire stock bloomed overnight in winter.
The village smith dreams of a blade that has not been forged.
Foxes have been leaving silver coins on doorsteps.
A stranger is collecting tolls at a bridge that was washed away.
A child drew a door on her wall, and it opens onto rain.
A book in the library rewrites itself every full moon.
The ferryman refuses to cross after sunset, and won't say why.
The market statue has turned to face a different road each morning.
Every pumpkin in the south field ripened on the same night.
A miner came up from the old adit speaking a language no one knows.
A knight in blank armor leaves offerings at the crossroads.
All the cats in town have begun following the same direction.
A baker's loaves spell out a warning when sliced.
A traveler's shadow stayed behind when they left the inn.
The orchard bears fruit twice a year now, and no one remembers planting it.

tables.description: A service a fantasy shop offers

blesses a journey for a handful of coins
charts a route on fresh parchment
takes pawns and holds them for a month
dyes cloth in a color of your choosing
